verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The customer-identification, greeting, consent, speech/keypad intent capture, AI self-service, escalation, contextual human handoff, bounded wait, and callback flow is represented with explicit directed paths and conditions.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The quality band shows recording and transcription, but it does not fully encode the universal requirement that every call is recorded and transcribed; the AI low-confidence escalation also omits the specific risk-flag qualifier.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board substantially covers the complete operating flow and all major failure, transfer, callback, and review-loop behavior. Three system-defining requirements are partial rather than absent: the low-confidence escalation lacks the stated risk-flag qualifier, and recording/transcription lack an explicit every-call scope. No system-defining requirement is absent or contradicted, so no cap applies.
